notes.title: Much Fixing Update!!!
notes.content: [p]We hear your feedback via other websites and email! Your input is invaluable to us and helps shape the improvements we make. Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts.[/p][p]Here’s the changelog highlighting the latest updates and fixes based on your feedback:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed many Grammars and Mistakes in the dialog! (Revised over [b]50 grammar fixes, Capitalization fixes, Punctuation improvements[/b], [b]and Contraction improvements)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Changed In-Game Font for better readability[/p][/*][*][p]You can be able to change the Name of the MC! (YES, Now Finally not Bombarded by MC hahaha)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 3 Images Not Found In-Game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]More Quality Life Update Soon![/p]

notes.title: Feedback!!!

Every comment counts![/p][p]Thanks for being part of our community and helping us grow![/p]

notes.title: Released!!!!
notes.content: Released!!!! The Game is now Released! Enoy the first update

notes.title: Sorry about that...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45516913/425361e388abdf66a220b87b7d5e614d10b608a1.png[/img]

Sorry about that... It will be on next 1-2Weeks. Thanks for your patience

I just wanted to apologize for the delay and thank you so much for your patience and understanding. The update or event will be happening within the next 1 to 2 weeks, and I truly appreciate you bearing with us during this time. We’re working hard to make sure everything goes smoothly and meets your expectations.

If you have any questions or need anything in the meantime, please don’t hesitate to reach out. Thanks again for your support - it really means a lot!
